title: 制御工学Ⅱ
subtitle: Control Engineering II
keywords: Stability criteria 2.Gain and phase margin 3.PID control 4.State space representation 5.Behavior of dynamic system
educationalGoal: (1) Learn the stability and control performance of dynamic systems and learn proportional integral derivative (PID) control. (2) Learn the state space representation, state transition matrix, and behavior of dynamic systems. (3) Acquire basic knowledge for state feedback control. (4) Acquire basic knowledge and skills for control system design and analysis.
advice: This is another basic course in control engineering that follows completion of Control Engineering I. Students are expected to actively participate in class reviews of basic mathematics (e.g., differential equations and linear algebra). Students are expected to complete exercises independently and to identify their own abilities. Students will acquire basic knowledge and skills to control robotic and mechatronic systems.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of Mathematics for Robotics I and Control Engineering I. Sufficient mathematical skill (differentials, integrals, differential equations, and linear algebra).

activityGoals.body: Apply knowledge of differential equations and linear algebra to the design and analysis of dynamic systems.
Calculate gain and phase margins, and determine the stability of systems.
Understand PID control and apply this control method to systems.
Understand state space representation and obtain a mathematical model using this representation.
Understand the behavior of dynamic systems and perform design and analysis to control objects.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
